title: Elon Musk Mocks SoftBank's Reported $100B AI Fundraising Plan: 'Only A Fool Would Give Them Money'
key_facts: Musk wrote on X 'Only a fool would give them money' in response to a post about SoftBank's planned fundraise.
SoftBank reportedly sought to raise as much as $100 billion from Gulf investors for a new AI fund.
The Financial Times reported that Masayoshi Son held talks in recent weeks with senior figures in the United Arab Emirates and other Gulf investors.
The fund would acquire companies and improve their operations using AI and other advanced technologies.
SoftBank has committed billions of dollars to OpenAI, which Musk has sued over its shift from nonprofit to for-profit.
SoftBank raised more than $11 billion in a high-yield bond sale last month, with yields reaching 9.75%.
The article is Stocktwits' own, carried on Yahoo Finance.
quote_evidence: "Only a fool would give them money," Musk wrote on X in response to a post about a planned fundraise.
According to a Financial Times report, Son has held discussions in recent weeks with senior figures in the United Arab Emirates and other Gulf investors about raising as much as $100 billion.
SoftBank raised more than $11 billion through a high-yield bond sale last month, with yields reaching 9.75%, highlighting the cost of financing its bets.
why_it_matters_hint: Shows how contested SoftBank's AI financing is; the fund itself is only reported talks.
event_date: 9 Oct 2026 (Musk post); FT report undated in the article
notes: Yahoo Finance carries a Stocktwits article; Stocktwits is the source. The FT report date is not given. Our 9 Oct edition carried an FT argument that Son's AI plans outgrew SoftBank's finances.
